Bus-Truck Collision in Rewa Kills Five, Injures 30

A collision between a bus and a truck on National Highway 39 in Rewa, Madhya Pradesh, resulted in the deaths of five people and injuries to 30 others. Chief Minister Mohan Yadav expressed his condolences for the accident. He announced financial assistance of ₹2 lakh for the families of the deceased and ₹1 lakh for those who sustained serious injuries.
